title: Crimson Legion Idle.
author: RelapseCatAddict
selftext:
Been working on Crimson Legion Idle, a dark fantasy portrait idle RPG rebuilt in Unity. All the enemy sprites are AI-generated pixel art assets I sourced from itch.io (BKX1 is the creator of the assets) the challenge was figuring out how to make them actually work in a cohesive game with proper UI, VFX, and combat feel.

Still a WIP but coming together nicely. Dropping some screenshots of the enemy variety.

replies.author: RelapseCatAddict
replies.body: Thanks big dog! Glad you enjoyed my screenshots.

comments.author: TheSpriteWizard
comments.body: That sounds fun. I wonder how you did it. What kind of structure are you running?

replies.author: RelapseCatAddict
replies.body:
The game is built in Unity with URP. Enemy sprites are AI-generated pixel art assets I sourced from itch.io. Combat runs on an auto-battle idle loop with tap damage on top. 

I have separate systems for Power upgrades, Legion characters, Prestige, and a Pantheon system still in progress. 

VFX is handled with the Pixel Craft URP asset pack and audio runs through a priority-based mixer so nothing overlaps

And the coolest thing as well is I mostly used Unity new AI to create about 70% of all the math behind it. And it since the game isn’t too heavy on AI thinking. I believe I used about $20 in total for the AI tokens.

replies.author: RelapseCatAddict
replies.body: And there’s even more of those giant reasons to play!

replies.author: RelapseCatAddict
replies.body: Nope, it’s an asset pack from Itch Io. The creator is called BKX1 they made hundreds of these sprites, I brought the pack awhile back but couldn’t think of a game to use them in. Until now.
